claims.claim: Under section 165 of the National Insurance Law an offered job is suitable if it is of the main type worked in the last 3 years or matches the claimant's training or education, the wage is at least the dmei avtala they would receive, and it does not require moving home. A job 60 km or more away counts as requiring a move unless there is proper public transport or employer transport, with travel time over one hour counted as work time. The relaxation of the first two tests is by AGE, not by day 60 for everyone: under 25 after 14 days, 25-28 after 30 days, 28-35 after 60 days. In Hebrew: סעיף 165 לחוק הביטוח הלאומי (עבודה מתאימה).

claims.claim: Income during unemployment is offset per day, not by a flat percentage.
